$comment: Curated, not harvested. Devpost has no open API (its /api/hackathons endpoint returns 403), so entries here are added by hand or by the pipeline after opening the listing page and reading the real dates. Same rule as the rest of the paper: nothing is invented, and an entry that cannot be opened does not run. The build drops anything whose `deadline` has passed, so stale entries fall off on their own rather than rotting on the page.

fields.name: Exact event name as the organiser writes it.
fields.url: The listing page that was actually opened to verify the entry.
fields.prize: Total prize pool as stated, with currency.
fields.eligibility: One short line. Say plainly if it is students-only.
fields.verifiedAt: YYYY-MM-DD the listing was last opened and checked.
